name: Kouchibouguac National Park
policyReason: Parks Canada promotes on-leash dog walks here and lists no trail bans.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed, including at campgrounds and on Callanders Beach.

excerpts.quote: must be kept on a leash at all times
You and your dog will love a long on-leash walk along Callanders Beach, exploring tidal rock pools and maybe a spot of soft-shell clam fishing too—permit required.

dogRules.text: Pets must be leashed in campgrounds.
